title: Transport of an actual classical Weil filtration to the constructible heart
statement:
Fix a prime power $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$, as in [def-weil-punctual-weights]. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\mathcal G$ be a constructible Weil sheaf of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] whose underlying heart object is identified, by the rational lisse realization of [lem-tw-lisse-rational-realization], with a classical lisse $\Qlb$-sheaf $L$ of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], including its Weil isomorphism. Suppose a particular finite filtration of $L$ by classical lisse Weil subsheaves is given,
$$0=L_0\subset L_1\subset\cdots\subset L_r=L,$$
with classical lisse quotients $S_j=L_j/L_{j-1}$; exactness here means exactness on every geometric adic fibre. Then its terms, inclusions, quotient maps and Weil isomorphisms are realized in the sf raw/common-stage constructible heart, and form a finite filtration of $\mathcal G$ by constructible Weil subsheaves. Each sequence $0\to\mathcal G_{j-1}\to\mathcal G_j\to\mathcal S_j\to0$ is exact in that heart, and $\mathcal S_j$ realizes the prescribed $S_j$.

The fibre identifications intertwine the normalized local Frobenius operators of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], including their iterated point transports; consequently punctual purity and its weight agree on corresponding quotients. All the finitely many terms, maps, inverse Weil maps and exact sequences admit one common finite coefficient-field stage. This assertion also holds after replacing $k_0$ by any finite constant extension and using the iterated Weil structure there. The filtration of the zero object is allowed to be empty.
